skills.name: formatPhoneNumber
skills.card:
formatPhoneNumber — Rewrite a phone number in E.164, international or national form.
  needs: number: string
  optional: region: string
  e.g. "format this phone number" → {"number":"+44 20 7946 0958"}

number.label: phone number
number.prompt: Which phone number should I format?

region.label: default dialling code
region.description: the dialling code to assume when the number has no + prefix

examples: normalise this us number to e164
write this indian number in international form

validatePhoneNumber — Say whether a phone number has the right shape for its country.

number.label: phone number

region.label: default dialling code

skills.name: comparePrices
skills.card:
comparePrices — Rank several sizes or packs by value for money and say which is cheapest per unit.
  needs: options: array
  optional: unit: string
  e.g. "which is better value, 500ml for 1.20 or 1.5l for 3.30" → {"options":[{"name":"500ml bottle","price":1.2,"quantity":0.5},{"name":"1.5l bottle","price":3.3,"quantity":1.5}],"unit":"litre"}

options.label: options
options.prompt: Which options should I compare? Each needs a price and a quantity.

examples: which is better value, 500ml for 1.20 or 1.5l for 3.30
is the bigger box cheaper per kilo

skills.name: convertCookingMeasure
skills.card:
convertCookingMeasure — Convert a cooking measure between cups, spoons, millilitres and grams, using the ingredient to get weight right.
  needs: amount: number, from: string, to: string
  optional: ingredient: string
  e.g. "how many grams is 2 cups of flour" → {"amount":2,"from":"cups","to":"g","ingredient":"flour"}

from.label: from unit
from.prompt: From which measure? (cups, tbsp, tsp, ml, g)

ingredient.label: ingredient
ingredient.description: needed to go between volume and weight

examples: how many grams is 2 cups of flour

skills.name: fuelCostForTrip
skills.card:
fuelCostForTrip — Work out the fuel cost of a journey from distance, consumption and fuel price.
  needs: distance: number, price: number
  optional: litresPer100km: number, milesPerGallon: number, returnTrip: boolean
  e.g. "fuel cost for a 500km trip at 7.5 litres per 100km and 1.65 a litre" → {"distance":500,"litresPer100km":7.5,"price":1.65}

price.label: fuel price
price.prompt: What does the fuel cost per litre or gallon?

examples: fuel cost for a 500km trip at 7.5 litres per 100km and 1.65 a litre
how much fuel for 320 km at 6.2 L per 100
petrol cost for 300 miles at 32 mpg
fuel for a return trip of 120km
cost of driving 50 km at 5 litres per 100km

skills.name: scaleRecipe

ingredients.label: ingredients
ingredients.prompt: Which ingredients should I scale? One per line.

factor.label: multiply by
factor.prompt: By what factor? (2 to double, 0.5 to halve)

examples: double this recipe: 2 cups flour, 1 egg, 3/4 tsp salt
halve these: 1 cup sugar, 2 tbsp butter, 4 eggs
scale by 1.5: 500 g pasta, 200 ml cream
triple 1½ cups oats and ⅓ cup honey
double a list with a line that has no amount

skills.name: shippingTotal
skills.card:
shippingTotal — Total a basket — items, postage, free-delivery thresholds and tax.
  needs: items: array
  optional: shipping: number, freeShippingOver: number, taxRate: number, taxOnShipping: boolean
  e.g. "total this order with shipping" → {"items":[{"price":12.5,"quantity":2},{"price":8,"quantity":1}],"shipping":4.99,"freeShippingOver":50}

freeShippingOver.label: free shipping from
freeShippingOver.description: subtotal at which shipping becomes free

examples: am I close to free delivery
total with tax not charged on delivery

skills.name: splitBill
skills.card:
splitBill — Add a tip to a bill and split it between people, to the exact penny.
  needs: bill: number
  optional: tipPercent: number, people: integer, currency: string
  e.g. "split a 84.50 bill four ways with 15% tip" → {"bill":84.5,"tipPercent":15,"people":4}
examples: split a 84.50 bill four ways with 15% tip
dinner was 45.60, 12.5 percent tip, two people
bill of 200 split 8 ways with 10% service

skills.name: stackDiscounts
examples: an extra 15 percent off something already 30 percent off, on 200

skills.name: unitPrice
skills.card:
unitPrice — Work out the price per unit — per litre, per kilo, per item — so sizes can be compared.
  needs: price: number, quantity: number
  optional: unit: string
  e.g. "what is the price per litre of 2.4 litres for 3.60" → {"price":3.6,"quantity":2.4,"unit":"litre"}

unit.label: unit
unit.description: what the quantity is measured in

examples: what is the price per litre of 2.4 litres for 3.60
cost per item for a pack of 12 at 5.99
price per sheet for 240 sheets at 2.40
what does that work out to per litre: 3.60 for 1.5 litres

skills.name: checkArithmeticSteps
skills.card:
checkArithmeticSteps — Check each line of a worked calculation and find the first one that is wrong.
  needs: steps: array
  optional: tolerance: number
  e.g. "check my working" → {"steps":["2 + 3 * 4 = 14","14 - 4 = 10","10 / 2 = 5"]}

steps.label: steps
steps.prompt: Which steps should I check? Write each as "expression = answer".

examples: find the mistake in my working

skills.name: flashcardShuffle
skills.card:
flashcardShuffle — Shuffle a set of flashcards into a study order.
  needs: cards: array
  optional: seed: integer
  e.g. "shuffle my flashcards" → {"cards":["alpha","beta","gamma","delta","epsilon"]}

skills.name: gpaCalculate

courses.label: courses
courses.prompt: What are the grades and credit hours?

examples: calculate gpa for two A grades
what is my grade point average this term

skills.name: gradeNeeded

current.label: score so far %
current.prompt: What is the score so far, as a percentage?

completed.label: course done %
completed.prompt: What percentage of the course does that cover?

target.label: target grade %
target.prompt: What overall percentage are you aiming for?

examples: what do I need on the final to get 80 percent
what score do I need for a 90 average
can I still pass with 70 percent
do I still need to revise for the last test
what do I need to score to keep a 60 average
sitting at 72 with 30% of the marks still to come, what gets me to 75
I'm on 78 so far; what mark do I need on the remaining 25% to end on 80

skills.name: gradeQuiz
skills.card:
gradeQuiz — Mark a set of answers against an answer key and give the score, question by question.
  needs: answers: array, key: array
  optional: caseSensitive: boolean, ignoreSpacing: boolean
  e.g. "mark these answers against the key" → {"answers":["Paris","Berlin","Madrid"],"key":["Paris","Rome","Madrid"]}

key.label: answer key
key.prompt: What is the correct answer to each?

examples: mark these answers against the key
grade a test where several are wrong

skills.name: readingScheduleFromPages
skills.card:
readingScheduleFromPages — Turn a page count into a daily reading schedule.
  needs: totalPages: integer
  optional: pagesPerDay: integer, days: integer, startDate: string
  e.g. "reading schedule for 60 pages at 20 a day" → {"totalPages":60,"pagesPerDay":20,"startDate":"2026-09-01"}

pagesPerDay.label: pages per day
pagesPerDay.description: how many pages you read a day

startDate.label: start date
startDate.description: the first reading day - today by default

examples: reading schedule for 60 pages at 20 a day
how much should I read a day to finish 100 pages in 4 days
plan 45 pages at 20 pages a day

skills.name: spacedRepetitionSchedule

date.label: date learned
date.description: the day the material was first learned - today by default

intervals.label: review after (days)
intervals.description: days after the start date to review on

examples: spaced repetition schedule doubling each time
review dates one week and one month out
give me a revision plan from today
